prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas, FOUR animation frames, transparent PNG, for an existing retro side-view browser game.
Primary request: Transform the original Stunt Copter HORSE AND BUGGY into a Terminator-style chrome HORSE AND BUGGY. Preserve its instantly recognizable silhouette: little low hay carriage on the LEFT, its TWO large visible spoked wheels, drawbars/harness in the middle, and ONE horse pulling it on the RIGHT. This is the SAME familiar horse-drawn wagon after a liquid-metal takeover.
Input images: Image 1 is the original game's sprite sheet. Its SECOND ROW contains the horse and buggy: use that exact simple side-view layout and relative proportions as the structural reference. Do not copy its helicopter or people. Image 2 is Omacontra art: use ONLY the rich clustered arcade pixel shading and carefully highlighted mechanical materials, not its truck/drone design.
Subject: A small open chrome buggy with low rectangular bed and a gently arched mound of metal plates/ribs shaped like the original hay pile. Exactly TWO visible round spoked wagon wheels under the bed, one at each end, steel spokes and dark rims; no tank treads. The wagon comprises approximately 55 percent of total width. Two thin drawbars visibly connect its front to a slender skeletal robot HORSE occupying the right 40 percent. The horse has recognizably equine long muzzle, upright arched neck, pointed ears, exposed steel ribs, piston tendons, FOUR thin articulated horse legs and blunt HOOVES. One tiny red eye. A short wiry horse tail points toward the harness. Mechanical bridle. Horse's head only slightly taller than the wagon load. No rider, driver, people or skull person. No cat, wolf, dog, panther, claws, or monster torso.
Weapon: A small twin-tube rocket launcher mounted on top of the BUGGY, not the horse. Angle up and RIGHT about 45 degrees. Clear dark muzzle openings with silver lips. Launcher top just higher than horse ears. This must remain a quaint little horse carriage made menacing by chrome machinery, not a huge military tank.
Style/medium: Clean high-fidelity 16-bit arcade PIXEL ART, crisp small pixel clusters, strong dark contour, convincing silver chrome white specular bands, cool steel blue-gray shadows and subtle pale green reflections; restrained tiny red eye and one red indicator on buggy. Legible when reduced to approximately 180 pixels wide and 70 pixels tall. No painterly blur, photographic rendering, 3D render, vector line art, text, logos, labels, ground, drop shadows, or environment.
Composition: 2048x1024 canvas, exact TWO columns by TWO rows, each cell 1024x512. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background and gaps. FOUR full side-view frames of the identical connected horse and buggy moving RIGHT, one per cell. Each whole sprite must fit x=65..955 and y=95..440 WITHIN ITS CELL, wheels and hooves on baseline y=440. Same buggy, same horse, same size, same wheel centers, same launcher coordinates, same stable body placement in every frame. No parts cross cell boundaries. No stray particles or objects.
Animation frames in reading order: 1 walking stride with near front leg forward and near hind leg back; 2 legs passing beneath horse; 3 opposite diagonal legs extend; 4 second passing pose. Distinct natural trotting leg poses; mechanical horse torso and head remain consistent. Rotate wheel spokes between frames but keep wheel circles and axle positions fixed. Cart floor, wheel centers, harness, launcher, and horse torso must stay aligned across frames. These are animation cels, NOT four different designs.
Entire sheet uses true transparency including open spaces between spokes, under cart, and between horse legs. Keep silhouettes compact and all four cels separated.
runtime: Four chrome horse-and-buggy trotting frames replace the quadruped. Original generated alpha preserved. Crops, ground anchors, launcher origins and collision regions in src/liquid-assets.js. Existing liquid-hunter-atlas.png supplies only the mercury puddle and grenade-hand accessories.
